title: Goodoo.ai Go-to-Market Strategy
subtitle: A Targeted 12-Month Plan to Capture the Initial Market
description: The GTM strategy for the first 12 months is centered on a 'spearhead' model. We will leverage the high-trust, high-relevance channels of the CEO's personal network and the Belgian Odoo annual event to acquire a critical mass of ideal first users. The goal is not broad awareness, but deep penetration and validation within the Odoo PM community. This initial traction will fuel all future expansion.

initiatives.title: Founder's Circle Email Campaign
initiatives.description: Target the CEO's list of ~500 Odoo PMs. This is not a cold email blast; it's a personal invitation to an exclusive circle.
actions: Email 1 (Teaser): Announce a new tool for Odoo PMs, highlighting the core pain point of project memory loss
Email 2 (Demo): Share a compelling, 2-minute video demonstrating the visual artifact generation
Email 3 (Invite): Invite them to join the 'Founder's Circle' beta with an exclusive offer
initiatives.objective: Secure 50-100 sign-ups for the beta waitlist before the event

initiatives.title: Odoo Event Shock & Awe Package
initiatives.description: Prepare materials to make a significant impact at the Belgian Odoo event in September. The goal is to be the most talked-about new tool at the conference.
actions: Live Demo Script: A polished, 5-minute demo script focusing on the 'screen-to-guide' workflow
Event-Specific Landing Page: A simple page with a QR code for attendees to scan, offering an exclusive 'Odoo Event' deal
One-Pager Handout: A visually appealing summary of the problem, solution, and core features
initiatives.objective: Be fully prepared to capture leads, provide stunning demos, and convert attendees into beta users on-site

initiatives.title: High-Impact Event Presence
initiatives.description: Execute the plan at the Odoo event. The focus is on active engagement, not passive presence.
actions: Actively network and drive traffic to your booth/presence
initiatives.objective: Acquire at least 50 high-quality beta sign-ups directly from the event. Generate significant buzz within the Odoo partner and developer community.

initiatives.title: White-Glove Onboarding Program
initiatives.description: Treat the first 100 users (from emails and the event) like VIPs. Their success is your success.
actions: Personally onboard every single beta user via a 1-on-1 video call. Help them set up their first project and record their first meeting
Create a private Discord server or Slack channel for the 'Founder's Circle' to provide direct support and gather unfiltered feedback
initiatives.objective: Achieve a >70% activation rate (users who record at least 3 meetings) for the initial beta cohort. Identify your first 5-10 power users who can become case studies.

initiatives.title: Amplify with Case Studies
initiatives.description: Turn early adopter success into powerful marketing assets.
actions: Create detailed case studies (blog posts and short videos) showcasing how they use Goodoo.ai to solve specific problems
initiatives.objective: Develop a library of social proof to use in future marketing, on the website, and for sales enablement.

initiatives.title: Expand to New Channels
initiatives.description: Use the initial traction to expand into broader channels.
actions: Begin targeted content marketing. Write blog posts about Odoo project management challenges, and feature Goodoo.ai as the solution
Launch targeted LinkedIn ad campaigns at 'Project Managers' in the software industry, using case studies as the primary creative
initiatives.objective: Establish a repeatable, scalable channel for lead generation beyond the initial spearhead channels.
